blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Operations research supports decision-making in domains such as energy, economics, and healthcare. Solving operations research problems typically begins with optimization modeling, which translates a natural-language problem description into executable solver code. LLMs offer a promising way to automate this process, but they remain prone to errors. In practice, these errors can be divided into two categories: syntactic errors refer to solver code that fails to run successfully or is judged infeasible by the solver; semantic errors refer to solver code that successfully returns an objective value but violates the intent of the original problem. Since semantic errors do not trigger runtime failures, they are difficult to detect and rectify. To address this problem, we introduce SemOPT , a semantic-guided framework for correcting LLM-based optimization models. SemOPT combines a semantic reward model that distinguishes faithful math models from plausible but incorrect ones with an adaptive correction system that applies hierarchical reward-guided search over the modeling space. Experiments on seven optimization modeling benchmarks show that SemOPT establishes a new state of the art and achieves an average 7.6% accuracy improvement over the strongest baseline on complex datasets.
blocks.zh: 业务研究支持能源、经济和保健等领域的决策。 解决操作研究问题一般从优化模型开始,将自然语言问题描述翻译为可执行解码. LLMS为这一进程的自动化提供了一个很有希望的方法,但它们仍然容易出错。 在实践中,这些错误可以分为两类: 综合错误是指无法成功运行或被解码者判断为不可行的解码; 语义错误是指成功返回客观值但违反原问题意图的解码. 由于语义错误不会触发运行时间故障,因此很难发现和纠正. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了SemOPT,一个修正基于LLM的优化模型的语义指导框架. SemOPT将一个将忠实的数学模型与可能但错误的数学模型区分开来的语义奖励模型与一个适应性的校正系统结合起来,在建模空间上应用等级奖励指导搜索. 对7个优化模型基准的实验表明,SemOPT建立了新的技术水平,实现了比复杂数据集最强基线平均7.6%的精度提高.

blocks.en: Despite their promise, LLM-based modeling systems remain error-prone Yang et al. (2026) . We divide their failures into syntactic and semantic errors. Syntactic errors refer to solver code that fails to run successfully or is judged infeasible by the solver. These failures are directly exposed by execution or solver feedback. Semantic errors , in contrast, refer to solver code that runs successfully and returns an objective value but violates the intent of the original problem, typically through misunderstood constraints, incorrect objectives, or invalid modeling assumptions. These errors are harder to identify because execution feedback provides no explicit signal of the underlying logical mismatch. To quantify this issue, we prompt an LLM to generate solver code end-to-end on the optimization modeling benchmark IndustryOR Huang et al. (2025a) and execute the generated codes to categorize failures. As shown in Figure 1 , semantic errors are more prevalent than syntactic errors. Moreover, three rounds of self-reflection Shinn et al. (2023) correct 66.7% of syntactic errors but only 21.4% of semantic errors, confirming that semantic errors are the main bottleneck.

blocks.en: Recent work has started to recognize the importance of correcting semantic errors in optimization modeling, with search-based methods providing the most instructive direction. Autoformulator Astorga et al. (2025) uses Monte Carlo Tree Search(MCTS) to explore candidate math model components, while SolverLLM Li et al. (2025) incrementally constructs math models over structured elements with outcome-guided search. These methods broaden the hypothesis space beyond single-pass generation, but two limitations remain. First, they often rely on general-purpose LLM evaluators, which are not specifically trained to distinguish semantically faithful math models from plausible but incorrect ones. Second, their search spaces are usually organized around fine-grained mathematical components, entangling high-level modeling decisions with low-level implementation details. As a result, when an error stems from an incorrect modeling strategy, these methods tend to revise local equations rather than backtrack to the reasoning step where the error actually originated.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作已经开始认识到在优化模型时纠正语义错误的重要性,以搜索为基础的方法提供了最有启发性的方向. Autoformator Astorga et al. (2025)使用蒙特卡洛树搜索(MCTS)来探索候选数学模型组件,而SolverLLM Li et al. (2025)在结构化元素之上逐步构建数学模型,并采用结果导向搜索. 这些方法将假说空间拓宽到单通道生成之外,但仍有两个局限性. 首先,他们往往依靠一般用途的LLM评价员,这些评价员没有经过专门培训,能够区分精密忠实的数学模型和可信但错误的数学模型。 其次,他们的搜索空间通常围绕精细的数学组件来组织,将高层次的建模决策包裹在低层次的执行细节上. 因此,当错误源于不正确的建模策略时,这些方法往往修改局部方程,而不是回溯到错误实际起源的推理步骤.

blocks.en: To overcome these challenges, we propose SemOPT , a semantic-guided framework for correcting LLM-based optimization models. SemOPT first trains a semantic reward model to evaluate the logical faithfulness between a problem description and generated solver code. It then uses this reward signal to guide hierarchical search over three stages: modeling strategy , math model , and solver code , allowing the framework to revise errors at the appropriate level of abstraction. Finally, an adaptive gating mechanism triggers search only when the initial solver code falls below the semantic confidence threshold, reducing unnecessary computation on straightforward instances. Experiments across seven benchmarks show that SemOPT establishes a new state of the art on most datasets.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些挑战,我们提议采用SemOPT,一种语义指导框架,以纠正基于LLM的优化模型。 SemOPT首先训练一个语义奖励模型,来评价一个问题描述和生成解码之间的逻辑忠诚度. 然后它利用这个奖励信号来指导分级搜索在三个阶段:建模策略,数学模型,和解码器代码,允许框架在适当的抽象层次修正错误. 最后,一个适应性的标注机制只有在初始解码低于语义置信阈值时才会触发搜索,从而减少在直截了当的情况下不必要的计算. 跨越七个基准的实验表明,SemOPT在大多数数据集上建立了一种新的最新技术。

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We identify semantic errors as a core bottleneck in LLM-based optimization modeling and design a dedicated semantic reward model for error localization and faithfulness evaluation. • We introduce a semantic-guided correction mechanism that uses the reward model to guide hierarchical search, and an adaptive gating mechanism balances accuracy and inference cost. • Extensive experiments across seven benchmarks demonstrate that SemOPT achieves a 7.6% accuracy improvement over the strongest baseline on complex datasets.

3 Semantic Reward Model
blocks.zh: 3 语义奖励模式

blocks.en: We train a semantic reward model R R to assess whether generated solver code is faithful to the input problem. We instantiate R R with a pre-trained LLM backbone Michailidis et al. (2024) and replace the language modeling head with a value head that outputs a continuous scalar. During inference, this scalar is normalized with a sigmoid function to produce a confidence score in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] for adaptive gating. During training, the raw value is used in the contrastive objective. The training pipeline consists of two steps: constructing preference data and learning R R from pairwise comparisons.

blocks.en: 5.2 Overall Performance
blocks.zh: 5.2 总体业绩

blocks.en: Main Results. As shown in Table 1 , SemOPT obtains the best results on most datasets, with especially clear gains on complex benchmarks. On ComplexOR, SemOPT reaches 72.2% accuracy, surpassing the strongest baseline by 9.2%. The small gap between the Best-of-N and Pass@N results of SemOPT shows that the reward model reliably selects semantically faithful candidates when they appear in the sampled set.
blocks.zh: 主要成果。 如表1所示,SemOPT在大多数数据集中获得最佳结果,在复杂的基准方面特别明显。 在ComplexOR上,SemOPT达到72.2%的精度,超过最强基线9.2%。 SemOPT的Best-of-N和Pass@N结果之间的小差距表明,奖励模式在选集中出现时可靠地选择了精诚忠实的候选人.

blocks.en: We make further observations as follows: 1) Standard and workflow methods lag behind on complex applied datasets, showing that generation or workflow decomposition alone is insufficient without a semantic verification signal. 2) Fine-tuned methods , especially SIRL, are strong on simpler datasets but less consistent on complex tasks, indicating that fine-tuning helps translate explicit requirements but still misses implicit constraints in long-context problems. 3) Search-based methods improve over single-pass generation but remain below SemOPT . Their reliance on general-purpose evaluators and on flat search makes recovery from strategy-level modeling errors difficult, whereas SemOPT backtracks across modeling strategy, math model, and code.
blocks.zh: 我们提出以下进一步意见: 1) 标准方法和工作流程方法在复杂的应用数据集上落后,表明单是生成或工作流程分解是不够的,没有语义验证信号. 2) 精细调整的方法,特别是SIRL,在较简单的数据集上很强,但在复杂的任务上却不太一致,这表明精细调整有助于翻译明确的要求,但仍忽略了在长文本问题上的隐含限制. 3) 搜索方法在单通道生成上有所改进,但仍低于SemOPT。 它们依赖通用评价员和扁平搜索,使得很难从战略层面的建模错误中恢复,而SemOPT则在建模战略、数学模型和代码上反向跟踪。

blocks.en: Objective-value matching is the standard protocol on these benchmarks, but it can credit a semantically incorrect formulation whenever that formulation happens to attain the same optimum. We therefore additionally validate SemOPT at the formulation level on 100 LP problems with reference formulations, scoring predictions by graph edit distance and human audit alongside objective matching. SemOPT improves over the strongest fine-tuned baseline under all three criteria, indicating that the gains extend to formulation faithfulness rather than final-answer matching alone. Appendix D details the protocol and the full results.

SemOPT consistently outperforms standard prompting in Best-of-N settings across all tested generators. These gains indicate that the semantic correction framework generalizes across LLM backbones rather than depending on a single generator.

blocks.en: 5.4 Efficiency

blocks.en: We evaluate efficiency from two perspectives: whether SemOPT improves over common iterative and search baselines under comparable budgets, and whether reward-guided search avoids the cost of exhaustive hypothesis enumeration.
blocks.zh: 我们从两个角度评价效率:SemOPT是否比可比预算下的共同迭代和搜索基线有所改善,以及奖励指导的搜索是否避免了详尽无遗的假设列举的成本.

Under this setting, SemOPT achieves the highest accuracy while using less time and fewer API calls. This result shows that the improvement of SemOPT comes from more effective semantic reward-guided correction rather than a larger inference budget.

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: LLMs for Optimization Modeling. Recent work on LLM-based optimization modeling falls into four groups. Standard methods such as Reflexion Shinn et al. (2023) refine math models through iterative feedback. Workflow frameworks, including OptiMUS AhmadiTeshnizi et al. (2024) and Chain-of-Experts Xiao et al. (2024) , decompose modeling into multi-agent pipelines. Fine-tuned models, such as ORLM Huang et al. (2025a) and SIRL Chen et al. (2025) , adapt LLMs with domain-specific instruction tuning or reinforcement learning. Search-based approaches, including Autoformulator Astorga et al. (2025) and SolverLLM Li et al. (2025) , explore broader hypothesis spaces beyond single-pass generation. These methods improve modeling ability, but mainly target feasible or superficially plausible math models rather than semantic consistency with problem requirements.
blocks.zh: 优化模型的LLMs. 最近关于基于LLM的优化模型的工作分为四组. Reflexion Shinn等人(2023年)等标准方法通过迭代反馈完善数学模型. 工作流程框架,包括OptiMUS AhmadiTeshnizi等人(2024年)和专家链 Xiao等人。 (2024),将模型分解为多剂管线. 精细调制的模型,如ORLM Huang等人(2025a)和SIRL Chen等人(2025),对LLMS进行适应,并带有特定域的指令调制或强化学习. 基于搜索的方法,包括Autoformator Astorga等人(2025年)和SolverLLM Li等人. (2025),探索超越单通道生成的更广泛的假设空间. 这些方法提高了建模能力,但主要是针对可行或表面可信的数学模型,而不是语义上与问题要求的一致性.

blocks.en: Error Correction in Optimization Modeling. LLMs produce modeling errors through hallucinated or misinterpreted problem structure Xie et al. (2025) , commonly categorized as syntactic or semantic errors Wang et al. (2025) . Syntactic errors occur when generated solver code fails to run or is judged infeasible; execution or solver feedback directly exposes them. OptLLM Zhang et al. (2024) and ORThought Yang et al. (2026) refine code from tracebacks, while LLMOPT Jiang et al. (2025) reduces such errors through domain-specific fine-tuning. Semantic errors occur when solver code runs and returns an objective value but violates the original problem intent through misunderstood constraints, incorrect objectives, or invalid modeling assumptions. Although semantic error correction has been studied for LLM-generated content Yang et al. (2025b) ; Gu et al. (2025) ; Islam et al. (2024) , work targeting optimization modeling remains limited. Autoformulator Astorga et al. (2025) and SolverLLM Li et al. (2025) address this issue through broader search and candidate selection, but rely on general-purpose verifiers that lack the domain sensitivity needed to separate plausible math models from semantically correct ones.
blocks.zh: 优化建模中的错误校正 。 LLMS通过幻觉或误解的问题结构Xie等人(2025年)产生模型错误,通常被归类为合成或语义错误. 王等 (2025) (中文(简体) ). 当生成的解码器代码无法运行或被判断为不可行时会发生银河错误;执行或解码器的反馈直接暴露它们. 缩写LM 张等(2024年)和ORTHET Yang等. (2026)从溯源改进代码,而LLMOPT Jiang等人(2025)则通过特定域的微调来减少此类错误. 当解码器代码运行并返回一个客观值时发生语义错误,但通过错误的制约,错误的目标,或无效的建模假设来违反最初的问题意图. 虽然对LLM生成的内容Yang等人(2025年b),Gu等人(2025年),Islam等人(2024年)进行了语义错误校正研究,但针对优化模型的工作仍然有限. Astorga et al. (2025)和 SolverLM Li et al. (2025年)通过更广泛的搜索和候选人选择来解决这一问题,但依赖缺乏域敏感度的通用验证器来将假想数学模型与模拟正确模型区分开来.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We propose SemOPT , a framework for correcting semantic errors in LLM-based optimization modeling. SemOPT combines a pairwise-trained semantic reward model with semantic-guided MCTS over modeling strategies, math models, and solver code, while adaptive gating invokes search only when the initial solver code falls below the semantic confidence threshold. Comprehensive experiments across seven benchmarks show that SemOPT achieves the best results on most datasets, with especially strong gains on complex benchmarks. These results support semantic-guided search for reliable optimization modeling.
blocks.zh: 我们提出SemOPT,一个纠正基于LLM的优化模型中的语义错误的框架. SemOPT在模型策略,数学模型,以及解码器代码之上,将一个经过对等训练的语义奖励模型与语义制导的MCTS结合,而适应性的Gating只有在初始解码低于语义置信阈值时才会引用搜索. 跨越七个基准的全面实验表明,SemOPT在大多数数据集上都取得了最佳成果,在复杂的基准上特别有重大收益. 这些结果支持语义引导搜索可靠的优化模型.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: This work focuses on automated optimization modeling from natural-language problem descriptions to executable solver code. Although SemOPT improves semantic consistency across seven benchmarks, our evaluation is still centered on benchmark tasks rather than deployed decision-making workflows. The framework also assumes access to solver execution and reward-model training data for constructing semantic supervision. Future work will further investigate this direction in broader real-world settings, including domain transfer, more diverse optimization tasks, and more efficient semantic-guided search.
blocks.zh: 这项工作侧重于从自然语言问题描述到可执行解码的自动化优化模型. 虽然SemOPT改进了七个基准的语义一致性,但我们的评价仍然以基准任务为中心,而不是部署决策工作流程。 该框架还假定可以获得用于构建语义监督的解答器执行和奖励模式培训数据。 今后的工作将在更广泛的现实世界环境中进一步调查这一方向,包括域转移,更多样化的优化任务,以及更有效的语义指导搜索.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: SemOPT is intended as a research framework for improving the reliability of LLM-based optimization modeling. The main societal risk is over-reliance on automatically generated solver code in high-stakes decision-making settings. Executable optimization models still sometimes encode incorrect objectives, omit important constraints, or reflect inappropriate assumptions about the problem context. Such errors create risks of harmful decisions when used without expert review. We therefore recommend that generated models be audited by domain experts before deployment. The work uses existing optimization-modeling benchmarks and does not collect human-subject data. The framework also uses commercial and open-weight LLMs, so reproducibility and environmental cost depend on model availability, API behavior, and compute budget. AI assistance was used only for language polishing and basic code drafting; it was not used to formulate the research idea, design the experiments, derive the claims, or generate the results.
blocks.zh: SemOPT旨在作为提高基于LLM的优化模型可靠性的研究框架. 主要的社会风险是过度依赖高额决策环境中自动生成的解码. 可执行优化模型仍然有时会编码错误的目标,省略重要的限制,或者反映对问题背景的不适当的假设. 这种错误在未经专家审查的情况下使用会造成有害决定的风险。 因此,我们建议域专家在部署之前对产生的模型进行审计。 工作采用现有的优化模型化基准,不收集人主体数据. 该框架还使用了商业和开放量的LLMs,因此再生产和环境成本取决于模型可用性,API行为,以及计算预算. AI援助只用于语言抛光和基本代码的起草;它不用于提出研究想法,设计实验,获得主张,或产生结果.

blocks.en: B.1 Semantic Mutation Operators
blocks.zh: B.1 语义突变操作员

blocks.en: Table 9 details the mutation operators used to construct hard semantic negatives for reward-model training. These operators are designed to preserve executable solver code whenever possible while perturbing the modeling intent. They cover three common sources of semantic error in optimization modeling: variable declarations, objective definitions, and constraints.
blocks.zh: 表9详细列出了用于构建硬语义底片用于奖励模式培训的突变操作员. 这些运算符的设计旨在尽可能保留可执行的解码,同时扰动建模意图. 它们涵盖了优化模型的语义错误的三个共同来源:可变声明,客观定义,以及制约.

blocks.en: Variable-level mutations alter the admissible solution space by relaxing variable types or removing bounds. Objective-level mutations change what the solver optimizes, either by flipping the optimization sense, changing coefficient signs, or dropping objective terms. Constraint-level mutations modify feasibility logic through comparator changes, right-hand-side shifts, variable swaps, index mismatches, or complete constraint removal. After the mutation process, candidates that fail execution or are judged infeasible are filtered out, so the remaining hard negatives correspond to executable but semantically incorrect solver code.
blocks.zh: 可变级突变通过放松可变类型或去除界限来改变可接受溶液空间. 目标层次的突变会改变解子最优化的东西,或者通过翻转优化感,改变系数标志,或者降低客观术语. 约束级突变通过参照物变化,右侧移位,可变互换,索引不匹配,或完全取消约束来修改可行性逻辑. 变异过程后,失败执行或被判断不可行的候选人会被过滤出,因此剩下的硬底片对应可执行但成像错误的解码.

blocks.en: C.1 Standard Methods
blocks.zh: C.1 标准方法

blocks.en: Standard Prompting is a single-pass generation baseline. It directly prompts the policy model to produce solver code from the problem description, without self-revision, external tool feedback, fine-tuning, or search. Self-Reflection follows the Reflexion framework Shinn et al. (2023) , which improves a language agent through verbal feedback stored in memory rather than parameter updates. In our setting, the model reflects on previous execution or solver feedback and regenerates solver code in later attempts.
blocks.zh: 标准提示是单通道生成基准. 它直接促使政策模型从问题描述中生成解码器代码,没有自译自审,外部工具反馈,微调,或搜索. 自引用遵循Reflexion框架Shinn等人(2023年),通过存储在内存中的口头反馈而不是参数更新来改进语言代理. 在我们的设置中,模型反射了之前的执行或解析器反馈,并在以后的尝试中重新生成解析器代码.

blocks.en: C.2 Workflow Methods
blocks.zh: C.2 工作流程方法

blocks.en: OptiMUS AhmadiTeshnizi et al. (2024) is a modular LLM-based system for modeling and solving (MI)LP problems from natural-language descriptions. It develops math models, writes and debugs solver code, evaluates generated solutions, and uses these evaluations to improve correctness and efficiency. Chain-of-Experts Xiao et al. (2024) is a multi-agent framework for complex OR problems. It assigns agents to specialized OR roles and uses a conductor to coordinate forward thought construction and backward reflection. OptiTree Liu et al. (2025) performs tree search over a hierarchical taxonomy of OR problem types. It identifies simpler subproblems and synthesizes global modeling thoughts from the selected hierarchy. SAC-Opt Zhang et al. (2025) uses semantic anchors extracted from the original problem and reconstructed from generated code. It aligns the two sets of anchors and selectively corrects mismatched objectives or constraints.
blocks.zh: OptiMUS AhmadiTeshnizi等人(2024年)是一个基于LLM的模块化系统,用于从自然语言描述中建模和解决(MI)LP问题. 它开发数学模型,写作和调试解析器代码,评价生成的解决方案,并利用这些评价提高正确性和效率. Experts Xiao et al. (2024)是一个处理复杂OR问题的多代理框架. 它指派代理人担任专门的OR角色,并使用导线来协调前向思想构造和后向反射. OptiTree Liu等人(2025年)对OR问题类型进行分级的树类搜索. 它识别了更简单的子问题,并综合了来自所选等级的全局模型思维. SAC-Opt Zhang et al. (2025)使用从原始问题中提取的语义锚,从生成代码中重建. 它协调了两组锚,并有选择地纠正了不匹配的目标或制约因素。

blocks.en: C.3 Fine-tuned Methods
blocks.zh: C.3 微调方法

blocks.en: ORLM Huang et al. (2025a) trains open-weight LLMs for optimization modeling using OR-Instruct, a semi-automated data synthesis framework. The resulting models are specialized for translating natural-language OR problems into math models and solver code. SIRL Chen et al. (2025) applies solver-informed reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. External optimization solvers evaluate executable code and the associated LP representation, providing rewards based on syntax, feasibility, and solution quality.
blocks.zh: ORLM 常规 Huang et al. (2025a) 使用OR-Instruct(半自动数据合成框架)进行优化模型的开放式LLMs列车. 由此产生的模型专门用于将自然语言OR问题翻译为数学模型和解码. 斯里兰卡 陈等. (2025)应用解析器知情强化学习,并有可核查的奖励. 外部优化解码器评价可执行代码和相关的LP代表,根据语法,可行性和解码质量提供奖励.

blocks.en: C.4 Search-based Methods
blocks.zh: C.4 基于搜索的方法

blocks.en: Autoformulator Astorga et al. (2025) formulates optimization models through MCTS over a hierarchical space of modeling choices. It uses symbolic pruning to remove redundant branches and LLM-based evaluation to score partial math models. SolverLLM Li et al. (2025) is a training-free test-time scaling framework. It generates math models and solver code through MCTS, using dynamic expansion, prompt backpropagation, and uncertainty backpropagation to guide the search process.
blocks.zh: Autoformator Astorga et al. (2025)通过MCTS在建模选择的层次空间上制定优化模型. 它使用象征性的普鲁恩来删除冗余分支和基于LLM的评价来评分部分数学模型. 解析器LLM 李等人(2025年)是一个无培训测试时间缩放框架. 它通过MCTS生成数学模型和解码器代码,使用动态扩展,促进反向传播,以及不确定性反向传播来引导搜索过程.

blocks.en: Appendix D Model-Level Semantic Validation
blocks.zh: 附录D 示范语义验证

blocks.en: Objective-value matching is the standard evaluation protocol on optimization-modeling benchmarks, but it credits a semantically incorrect formulation whenever that formulation happens to attain the reference optimum. This section reports a complementary validation of SemOPT at the formulation level.
blocks.zh: 目标价值比对是关于优化模型化基准的标准评价协议,但当这种配方恰好达到最佳参照标准时,它会给一种明显错误的配方留下印象。 本节报告SemOPT在编制层面的补充验证。

blocks.en: Evaluation Protocol. Following prior work on human-aligned evaluation of LP word problems Xing et al. (2024) , we convert the predicted and the reference LP model into attributed bipartite graphs and compute the graph edit distance (GED) between them. Variable nodes encode bounds and objective coefficients, constraint nodes encode constraint bounds, and edges encode variable–constraint coefficients. We report three metrics. GED Acc. counts a prediction as correct only when the edit distance is zero, which yields a strict lower bound on formulation correctness. Obj Acc. is the objective-matching metric used in the main experiments, which is an upper bound because a semantically wrong model can return the correct objective by coincidence. For instances on which the two criteria disagree, we manually audit the predicted and the reference formulation, and report the human-verified correctness rate as Oracle Acc.
blocks.zh: 评价协议。 在先前对LP词问题Xing等人(2024年)进行人与人结合评价之后,我们把预测的和参考的LP模型转换成归属双方图,并计算它们之间的图编辑距离(GED). 可变节点编码约束和客观系数,约束节点编码约束约束,边缘编码变量–约束系数. 我们报告三个标准。 一般临时人员 Acc. 仅在编辑距离为零时才将预测数算作正确,这在配方正确性上产生严格的下限. Obj Acc.是主要实验中使用的客观匹配度量衡,它是一个上限值,因为一个刻度错误的模型可以通过巧合返回正确的目标. 对于两种标准有分歧的事例,我们手动审核预测和参考表述,并将经人验证的正确率报告为甲骨文Acc.

blocks.en: Dataset. The benchmarks used in the main experiments either release only target objective values, contain too few formulation-level instances, or are too simple for the three metrics to separate meaningfully. We therefore extract 100 LP problems with explicit reference formulations from OptiVerse Zhang et al. (2026) , denoted OptiVerse-LP-100, and compare SemOPT against SIRL, the strongest fine-tuned baseline.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 主要实验中使用的基准要么只释放目标客观值,要么包含太少的配方级实例,要么过于简单,三个度量标准无法真正分离. 因此,我们从OptiVerse Zhang等人(2026年)中提取出100个LP问题,并用明确的参考配方表示OptiVerse-LP-100,并将SemOPT与SIRL(最强的微调基线)进行比较。

blocks.en: Table 12: Formulation-level validation on OptiVerse-LP-100.
blocks.zh: 表12:OptiVerse-LP-100的配制一级验证。

blocks.en: Results. As shown in Table 12 , SemOPT improves over SIRL by 8 points in GED Acc., 11 points in Oracle Acc., and 11 points in Obj Acc. The gain therefore extends to formulation faithfulness rather than final-answer matching alone. The small gap between GED Acc. and Obj Acc. also indicates that objective matching is a useful proxy for semantic correctness, although not a complete one.
blocks.zh: 结果。 如表12所示,SemOPT在GED Acc中比SIRL提高了8分,在甲骨文Acc中提高了11分,在Obj Acc中提高了11分. 因此,收益扩大到表述的忠实性,而不是仅仅最后的答案匹配。 GED Acc.和Obj Acc.之间的小差距也表明,客观匹配是语义正确性的有用代词,虽然不是一个完整的代词.

blocks.en: The two residual gaps have different causes. The Obj–Oracle gap corresponds to false positives under objective matching. In OptiVerse-53, for instance, the problem specifies a total investment of 200,000 yuan, whereas SemOPT models it as an upper bound of at most 200,000 yuan; the optimum happens to exhaust the full budget, so the objective matches although the formulation does not. The GED–Oracle gap instead usually reflects imperfections in the reference model. In OptiVerse-678, the reference model imposes only non-negativity on the number of trucks, while SemOPT additionally imposes integrality; GED marks this as a mismatch even though the stricter formulation is semantically valid.
blocks.zh: 两个剩余差距有不同的原因。 Obj- Oracle 差距对应客观匹配下的假阳性. 例如,在OptiVerse-53案中,问题规定总投资为20万元人民币,而SemOPT则将其作为最多20万元人民币的上限;最理想的情况恰好是耗尽了全部预算,因此目标匹配,尽管配方没有. GED–Oracle漏洞通常反映参考模型中的不完善之处. 在OptiVerse-678中,参考模型仅对卡车数量强制非负性,而SemOPT则额外强制要求集成性;GED则将此标记为不匹配,尽管更严格的配体是精准有效的.

blocks.en: Counterfactual Sensitivity. We further test whether the reward model responds to specific problem statements rather than to surface features of the solver code. In ComplexLP-1, the original description requires food quantities to be integers, and the corresponding solver code encodes this integrality requirement, receiving a reward score of 0.72. We then modify only the problem description so that food quantities may be fractional, leaving the solver code unchanged. The reward score drops to 0.41. The reward model is thus sensitive to mismatches between individual problem requirements and the solver code, even though it emits a scalar score without sentence-level rationales.
blocks.zh: 反事实感应. 我们进一步检验奖励模式是否对具体问题陈述作出反应,而不是对解码器的表面特征作出反应. 在ComplexLP-1中,最初的描述要求食物数量为整数,相应的解码编码了这个整体性要求,得到0.72的奖励分数. 然后我们只修改问题描述,使食物数量可能分数,使解码不变. 奖励分数降至0.41分. 奖励模式因此对单个问题要求和解码之间的不匹配十分敏感,尽管它释放出一个没有句子级别理由的分数.

blocks.en: E.2 Sampling Efficiency
blocks.zh: E.2 抽样效率

blocks.en: We further analyze the impact of the node expansion size H H on the performance of SemOPT . As illustrated in Figure 6 , we evaluate both Best-of-N and Pass@N metrics across NL4Opt, ComplexLP, and ComplexOR. The results indicate that while accuracy consistently improves as H H increases from 1 to 10, the performance gain saturates rapidly. Specifically, the accuracy typically reaches a plateau around H = 4 H=4 across all datasets. This observation demonstrates the high sampling efficiency of our framework. It indicates that SemOPT achieves near-optimal performance with a minimal computational budget, justifying our selection of H = 4 H=4 as the default setting for the main experiments as reasonable.

blocks.en: Appendix F Result Variability Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录F 结果可变性分析

blocks.en: F.1 Run-to-Run Variation
blocks.zh: F.1 径向变化

blocks.en: To assess the stability of the hard-subset comparison, Table 14 reports mean accuracy with run-to-run variation on the hard subsets of NL4Opt, ComplexLP, and ComplexOR. Each value is computed over repeated runs on the same instances; the reported ± \pm values therefore describe variation induced by stochastic generation and MCTS exploration, rather than uncertainty over the benchmark population. SemOPT improves over the strongest baseline on all three hard subsets, with the largest margin on ComplexOR. The relatively higher variation on NL4Opt reflects the fact that several instances lie near the decision boundary, so small changes in the sampled search trajectory can change the selected solution. Despite this variance, the mean accuracy of SemOPT remains above the strongest baseline in every setting, confirming that the improvement is not attributable to a single favorable run.
blocks.zh: 为了评估硬子集比较的稳定性,表14报告是指NL4Opt、ComplexLP和ComplexOR硬子集的运行变化的准确性。 每个数值都是在相同情况下重复计算得出的;因此,所报告的±\\pm值描述的是随机生成和MCTS探索引起的变化,而不是基准人群的不确定性。 SemOPT改进了所有三个硬子集的最强基线,其中ComplexOR的比值最大. NL4Opt上相对较高的变异反映了数例位于决定边界附近的事实,因此抽样搜索轨迹的小变化可以改变选定的解决方案. 尽管存在这种差异,SemOPT的平均准确度仍然高于每个设定中最强的基线,这证明改进不是一次有利运行的结果。

blocks.zh: 表14:硬子集精度有变异.

blocks.en: F.2 Paired Hard-Subset Analysis
blocks.zh: F.2 硬体分析

blocks.en: Run-to-run variation alone does not quantify uncertainty caused by the finite number of test instances. We therefore report absolute counts and paired instance-level tests in Table 15 . The confidence interval is a 90% conditional exact interval for the paired net gain, computed from discordant pairs and scaled by the number of instances. The p p -value is from the exact two-sided McNemar/binomial test on the same discordant outcomes.
blocks.zh: 仅靠运行到运行的变异并不能量化试验案例数量有限的所造成的不确定性. 因此,我们在表15中报告绝对数和对等实例的测试。 置信间隔是成对净收益的90%的有条件精确间隔,从不相配的对数计算,并按例数缩放. p -值来自同一不和结果上的精确的双侧麦克尼玛/二元测试.

blocks.en: Table 15: Paired analysis on hard subsets. Counts are the number of solved instances over the subset size.

blocks.en: The combined hard subsets contain 79 instances, on which SemOPT wins seven paired cases and loses one, yielding a 7.6-point net gain and a positive 90% interval. The ComplexOR-hard result is based on only seven instances (2/7 versus 4/7), so it should be interpreted as supportive rather than conclusive evidence. Taken together with the repeated-run results above, the paired counts provide a more complete picture: the advantage persists across the combined hard set, while the small ComplexOR subset warrants caution.
blocks.zh: 合并的硬子集包含79个实例,其中SemOPT胜7对案例,输1对,产生7.6分净收益,正90%间隔. ComplexOR-hard结果仅基于7个案例(2/7对4/7),因此应被解释为支持性证据而不是决定性证据。 结合以上重复运行的结果,对数提供了更为完整的图象:优势在组合硬盘上持续存在,而小的ComplexOR子集则值得谨慎。

blocks.en: Appendix G Error Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录G 错误分析

blocks.en: G.1 Syntactic Error Handling
blocks.zh: G.1 协同错误处理

blocks.en: This section specifies how syntactic and runtime errors are accounted for during search. When a rollout reaches a solver-code leaf, the code is executed. If the solver or the Python runtime reports an error, the error message is appended to the context and the generator regenerates the code for up to K K reflection rounds. If execution still fails after K K rounds, the rollout receives a score of 0 0 and is not passed to the semantic reward model.Every node that initially triggers an error undergoes regeneration, and its final score enters backpropagation like any other node.
blocks.zh: 本节具体说明在搜索过程中如何计算同步错误和运行时间错误。 当一个推出到一个解码叶时,该代码会被执行. 如果解析器或 Python 运行时报告出错,错误消息会附在上下文中,生成器会重新生成高达K K 反射回合的代码. 如果在K K 回合后执行仍然失败,则推出获得0分的分数,不会被传给语义奖励模式. 最初触发错误的每一个节点都会经历再生,其最终分数会像任何其他节点一样进入反扩散.

blocks.en: Table 16: Syntactic error handling during search. The error rate is computed over all evaluated nodes; repair outcomes are computed over the nodes that initially triggered repair.
blocks.zh: 表16:搜索过程中的表征错误处理. 在所有评估的节点上计算出误差率;在最初启动修理的节点上计算出修理结果。

blocks.en: Table 16 reports the resulting statistics. Roughly one third of the evaluated nodes on IndustryOR and ComplexLP trigger at least one execution error, and the rate rises to 46.8% on ComplexOR, whose problems involve larger and more heavily indexed models. Reflection repairs the majority of these cases, and the remaining nodes are assigned a score of 0 0 . This separates code-level execution handling, which relies on solver feedback, from semantic correction, which is applied only to code that already runs.
blocks.zh: 表16报告了由此产生的统计数据。 估计有三分之一的IndustryOR和ComplexLP评价的节点至少触发了一个执行错误,而ComplexOR的节点率上升至46.8%,其问题涉及更大的和更多的指数化模型。 反射修复这些案例的大部分,其余的节点被分配到0分. 这把依赖于解析器反馈的代码级执行处理与语义校正区分开来,这只适用于已经运行的代码.

blocks.en: G.2 Semantic Error Taxonomy
blocks.zh: G.2 语义错误分类学

blocks.en: To characterize the errors that remain after correction, we analyze the 40 instances that SemOPT still answers incorrectly under BoN on IndustryOR, ComplexLP, and ComplexOR. We first categorize each error by the layer of the search hierarchy at which it originates, then further categorize the math-model errors by the component of the formulation that is wrong.
blocks.zh: 为了描述更正后仍然存在的错误,我们分析了SemOPT在BON下关于IndustrialOR, ComplexLP, 和ComplexOR的40个例子。 我们首先按其起源的搜索层次层对每个错误进行分类,然后按照配方的成分进一步将数学模型错误进行分类.

blocks.en: Table 17: Distribution of the 40 remaining SemOPT errors by hierarchy layer, and of the 28 math-model errors by formulation component.
blocks.zh: 表17:其余40个SemOPT差错按等级层分布,28个数学模型差错按配方成分分布.

blocks.en: As Table 17 shows, most residual errors occur at the math-model layer, and constraints are the single largest source within that layer. This is consistent with the observation that constraints carry the implicit requirements of a problem description and are therefore the hardest component to recover from natural language. Only 7.5% of the errors are introduced at the solver-code layer, indicating that implementation is rarely the bottleneck once a faithful math model is available. The 22.5% of errors that originate at the strategy layer support including an explicit strategy layer in the search hierarchy, since an incorrect optimization framework or variable definition cannot be repaired by later layers. The taxonomy also suggests a practical ordering for future improvements: stronger extraction of implicit constraints should address the dominant error source, while better strategy classification can prevent errors from propagating into every downstream representation. In contrast, additional code-level repair is likely to have a smaller effect once the generated program is already executable.
blocks.zh: 如表17所示,大多数剩余误差发生在数学模型层,制约是该层内最大的单一源. 这符合以下观点,即制约因素带有问题描述的隐含要求,因此是最难从自然语言中恢复的成分。 在解码层只引入7.5%的误差,表明一旦有忠实的数学模型,执行就很少成为瓶颈. 起源于策略层的22.5%的错误支持包括搜索层级中明确的策略层,因为一个不正确的优化框架或可变定义无法由后层修复. 分类学也为未来的改进提出了实用的顺序:更有力地提取隐含限制应该解决主错源,而更好的策略分类可以防止错误传播到每一个下游代表. 相比之下,在生成的程序已经可执行的情况下,额外的代码级修复可能会产生较小的效果.

blocks.en: Appendix H Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录H 定性分析

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 7 , we present a case study on “IndustryOR-37” to illustrate how SemOPT resolves semantic ambiguities. The core challenge of this problem involves an implicit “backlogging” constraint. This allows for unmet demand to be carried over to subsequent periods, a logic that contradicts standard non-negative inventory assumptions.
blocks.zh: 如图7所示,我们提出了一份关于“工业-37”的案例研究,以说明SemOPT如何解决语义上的模糊问题。 这一问题的核心挑战涉及隐含的“回扣”制约。 这使得未满足的需求可以结转到以后的期间,这一逻辑与标准的非负存货假设相矛盾.

blocks.en: Failure of Direct Inference. As shown in the figure, the direct inference (System 1) fails to capture this hidden requirement. It generates a standard inventory balance equation that assumes non-negativity, leading to an invalid model.
blocks.zh: 直接推论失败. 如图所示,直接推论(System 1)未能抓住这一隐性要求. 它生成一个标准库存平衡方程,该方程假设非负态,导致一个无效模型.

blocks.en: Reasoning Process of SemOPT . In contrast, through its capacity of semantic discrimination, SemOPT manages to figure out the correct answer. SemOPT activates MCTS to explore the modeling space. At the leaf nodes, the semantic reward model distinguishes between plausible but incorrect math models. As shown in the figure, the model assigns the highest confidence score of 0.56 to the math model that explicitly incorporates the backlog variable. In contrast, it assigns a lower score of 0.44 to the candidate that omits this variable. This effectively suppresses the semantically misaligned solution. Both candidates are executable, so solver feedback alone cannot distinguish them; the decision depends on whether the formulation captures the problem’s implicit backlog logic. This trajectory confirms that SemOPT uses the reward model to actively reason through conflicting constraints and successfully rectifies semantic errors that standard prompting methods fail to identify.
blocks.zh: SemOPT的理性过程. 相比之下,SemOPT通过其语义歧视的能力,设法找出正确的答案。 SemOPT激活MCTS探索建模空间. 在叶节点,语义奖励模型区分了可能但错误的数学模型. 如图所示,模型为明确包含积压变量的数学模型分配了0.56的最高置信分. 相比之下,它为省略这个变量的候选人分配了0.44的较低分数. 这有效地压制了这种混乱的解决办法。 两个候选人都是可执行的,因此单靠解答者反馈无法区分它们;决定取决于公式是否抓住了问题的隐性积压逻辑. 这个轨迹证实了SemOPT使用奖励模型通过相互矛盾的制约来积极推理,并成功纠正标准提示方法无法识别的语义错误.
